research.title: Retrieval Sensitivity in Document-Grounded Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance and distractor placement to examine answer grounding in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and unsupported claims across retrieval conditions, separating evidence selection failures from generation errors through manual review.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness of Negation-Aware Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed cross-domain experiments comparing lexical and contextual sentiment classifiers, with evaluation subsets targeting negation scope and contrasting sentiment clauses.
Analyzed classification errors across review domains and training conditions, using bootstrap intervals and ablations to assess sensitivity to negation cues.

publications.title: Negation and Domain Shift in Sentiment Classification: A Comparative Evaluation of Lexical and Contextual Models

work.title: Support Ticket Processing and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned changes to ticket text normalization and duplicate detection, preserving existing interface contracts and documenting edge cases.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and investigated search indexing failures using application logs and reproducible test cases.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and transformer token classification baselines with consistent token alignment and shared training, validation, and test partitions.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors, rare entity categories, and sensitivity to reduced training data.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for FAQ Matching
bullets: Implemented lexical ranking and sentence embedding retrieval for matching user questions to FAQ entries under a shared evaluation protocol.
Compared ranking quality across paraphrase and vocabulary mismatch subsets, inspecting retrieved candidates to characterize lexical overlap and semantic confusion.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Graph Ranking and Sentence Centroids
bullets: Implemented graph-based sentence ranking and centroid-based selection for document summarization, applying identical preprocessing and summary length constraints.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual redundancy checks, analyzing how sentence position and document structure affected content selection.
